source.population: 106 radiographically normal adults, 56 men/50 women, age 20–50; clinically referred. Standing knees straight, arms folded on chest.

measurement: Same-body superior versus inferior endplate lines; positive lordotic, negative kyphotic. Segments are superior-to-superior and include body plus disc.
convergence: Upper lumbar kyphotic, L3 near neutral, lower lumbar lordotic. No numerical averaging with Bailey male data.
limitations: Pooled sex and posture/cohort differ from Bailey male pooled body means.
Distinct author/clinical recruitment from Bailey Seattle sample supports separate cohort context, not universal population target.
No stature conditioning; no new centres or frozen dimensions.
